name: propresenter-garage
description: Read a ProPresenter 7 library: search slide text, read presentations and playlists, run text checks, audit the media bin and preview themes. Read-only.
long_description: Reads ProPresenter 7 files from disk, through the same decoding and checks as the ProPresenter Garage browser app. List and search presentations, read their slides line by line, run the Presentations text checks, read or audit the media bin, read the presentation playlists, and list themes and preview giving a presentation one of their looks. It never writes a file, and it reads nothing outside the folders you choose.

library_folders.title: ProPresenter folders
library_folders.description: The folder holding your Libraries and Playlists, usually Documents/ProPresenter. Nothing outside the folders chosen here is read.

tools.name: list_presentations
tools.description: List presentation files, by name or by when they were last shown.

tools.name: read_presentation
tools.description: Read a presentation's slides line by line, with its dates, notes, CCLI details and arrangements.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Find a phrase in the slide text of every presentation.

tools.name: check_presentations
tools.description: Run the Presentations text checks on a file, a folder or every library.

tools.name: read_media_bin
tools.description: Read every playlist in the media bin and the items in it.

tools.name: audit_media_bin
tools.description: Find duplicates, empty playlists, hidden items and other media bin problems.

tools.name: read_playlists
tools.description: Read the presentation playlists: every service and the songs, headers and media in it.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List the themes and the slide styles each offers.

tools.name: preview_style
tools.description: Preview giving a presentation the look of a theme slide or another slide, without changing it.
